title: Autonomous investigation of anion-dependent 7-azaindole association
difficulty_reasons: The agent must propose plausible motifs and prioritize a broad set of AI-anion and AI2 candidates.
Eight complexes require coverage, deduplication, validation and independent counterpoise energetics.

paper.title: Dimer formation of 7-azaindole in phosphonium-based ionic liquids: anion-dependent behavior

data.description: Closed isolated AI and seven-anion identities, coordinates, charges and multiplicities.

required_deliverables.description: Autonomous hypotheses, validated per-complex structures, interaction energies, coverage and conclusions.
